milestone: M13/3 inline Matrix Parameter controls and whole-header selection
gate: Active; partial product delivery, not acceptance
ownership: MapGyver Matrix UI projects existing real Golden Parameters using the public editor registry and declaration-only graph indexes. No duplicate settings, protocol, backend defaults or persistence contract.
capability: Layer and Group headers show top-left titles and compact canonical Opacity/Blend Mode widgets.
Header backgrounds and Enter/Space select document objects while rename, launch and embedded controls retain their actions.
Inline control gestures cannot initiate row dragging. Generic edit-session, constraints, control-mode and history behavior is retained.

checks: Root Layer, Group and nested Layer use the exact Inspector Parameter IDs.
Opacity .375, all four blend modes, Inspector-to-inline .625, exact Undo/Redo snapshots and top-aligned labels pass for all three objects.
Slider gesture changes opacity without moving rows and is restored by one Undo and Redo after its edit session settles.
Actual blank Column header click and keyboard selection preserve launch; Layer rename passes.
Sparse 1000 rows by 1000 Columns authors zero Cells and mounts eight row-control groups at the observed scrolled viewport, within the 64-row bound.
Selected offscreen Layer remains editable in Inspector; returning to it shows .25. Same-ID project reload preserves all item settings and the inline value.
native.visual_review: inline-controls.png inspected: top-left hierarchy labels and compact editors, no overlap. This is an app-WebView UI check, not render pixels or timing qualification.

failed_attempts_retained.finding: Leaf declaration lookup omitted the parameters/ prefix; controls did not mount. Corrected to authoritative full declaration IDs.
Header click while the preceding edit projection was settling. Test now waits for panel readiness.
Slider Undo comparison failed. Removed HTML label activation around composite widgets; explicit session-settle waiting is also required by the test.
Assumed header-relative click position missed the actual background. Test now derives a real blank point through elementFromPoint, without dispatching synthetic selection.
Test incorrectly read playback from authoring Inspect; corrected to public InspectPlayback.
Undo was attempted before the slider edit session settled; wait for panel readiness before history actions.
Expected ARIA row count omitted the trailing creation row; real count is 1000+2.
Controls, offscreen editing and sparse bounds passed; load response has path/recovery rather than ok. Corrected response assertion.

remaining: Full M13/3 limiting/exact-fit/both-axis/dock/group scrollbar stability and narrow/large/scale checks.
Front Layer first/top throughout document hierarchy, all reorder callers and backend compositing, with native overlapping pixels.
Full sparse preview/resource lifetime acceptance; this zero-Cell control virtualization check does not replace it.
